recent_experiments.name: Stochastic Curvature-Driven Forward Gradient (SCDFG)
recent_experiments.principle: Estimates the loss gradient via central finite differences of the forward pass, leveraging the local quadratic approximation of the loss landscape to update weights in the direction of steepest descent without chain rule backpropagation.
